title: Dope.Pay
tagline: We are building a standlone POS machine to enable cross chain payment using Gasyard's Intent Engine
description:
WE at Gasyard have been working on cross chain Intent to make money moment across chains easier and frictionless. We did achieve sub 10 secs bridging for a lot of EVM chains like Base, Arb, ETH, Polygon, etc. 

Here we are buidling a standalone POS machine to facilitate cross chain transaction for merchants through the intent engine developed by Gasyard.

You can just choose the network which you want. and then just tap on the machine and get the balance credited in your wallet instantly.

The transaction is completed in less than 5 secs

we have added a feature for random donation amount using the Entropy functions from Pyth Networks
how_its_made:
We are using ESP32 micro controller and a MRC 22 RFID reader and connected the connections using jumper cables on a breadboard which is powered by a 5V cable.

All these are placed inside a carboard box and powered by a simple powerbank

After selecting the network you just have to tap the NFC card which has the intent and then after validation, transaction happens on blockchain and you receive the funds in the wallet on your desired chain
